item.description: Country the resort is in (France, Switzerland, Austria, Italy, Germany).
item.name: Country

item.description: Crowd Index banded, numbered so it sorts from quiet to packed: 1 Quiet (under 55), 2 Steady (55-64), 3 Busy (65-79), 4 Packed (80+).
item.name: Crowd Level

item.description: The airport guests fly into for this resort: the natural market for flight-based marketing.
item.name: Gateway Airport

item.description: Calendar month of the week's start date. Sorts in time order, unlike the Month text field.
item.name: Month

item.description: The ski resort (10 resorts, all fictional).
item.name: Resort

item.description: Ski season, December to March: 2024/25 or 2025/26.
item.name: Season

item.description: Week number within the season, 1 (first week of December) to 18 (last week of March). Lines up the two seasons week by week.
item.name: Season Week

item.description: NOT USED by the season measures; kept for ad-hoc analysis over MCP. A period-comparison measure on this axis is refused by the engine (error 013401, 'period-comparison calendar selection has no unambiguous time axis') whenever a query also filters a Season Weeks field (Season Stage, Week Type, Season Week), so the This/Last Season measures name the seasons explicitly. Anchored at 2026-04-05: with periodEnd 'latest' the comparison window dropped the last week of 2024/25.
item.name: Season Axis

item.description: Part of the season: Early season (weeks 1-3), Peak winter (4-8), Mid winter (9-13), Spring (14-18). Sorts alphabetically; order charts by First Season Week.
item.name: Season Phase

item.description: Part of the season, numbered so it sorts in time order: 1 Early season (weeks 1-3, early Dec), 2 Peak winter (4-8, Christmas to mid Jan), 3 Mid winter (9-13, late Jan to Feb), 4 Spring (14-18, March). Same split as the Season Phase field.
item.name: Season Stage

item.description: Fresh snow in the 7 days of the week, banded in 20 cm steps. Labels sort in band order.
item.name: Snowfall Band

item.description: Calendar week, by its Monday start date. One row per week.
item.name: Week

item.description: Holiday week (Christmas/New Year and the late-January/February school holiday week) or Regular week.
item.name: Week Type

item.description: Average Crowd Index (0-100): the only demand signal in the data, used as the proxy for visits. There is no visitor count. Up is good for the operator.
item.name: Avg Crowd Index

item.description: Avg Snow Score minus Avg Crowd Index, in index points: how much better the snow is than the demand it draws. A large gap marks resorts and weeks where conditions are good but crowds are thin, which is where extra marketing has most room. A modelling assumption: both are 0-100 indexes, not visits.
item.name: Demand Headroom

item.description: Earliest season week in the selection. Orders Season Phase chronologically.
item.name: First Season Week

item.description: Lowest weekly Crowd Index in the selection. Also orders Crowd Level bands.

item.description: What-if: a marketing budget (parameter budget, default EUR 250,000) split in proportion to each row's share of Target Weeks in the selection. A planning rule, not a forecast: it puts money where good snow went unsold.
item.name: Suggested Budget

item.description: Baseline for the marketing what-if: the default plan, EUR 250,000 split by each row's share of regular resort-weeks with at least 40 cm fresh snow and Crowd Index below 55. No parameters, so it stays fixed while the levers move Suggested Budget.
item.name: Suggested Budget at Default Rule

item.description: Campaign rule for the marketing what-if: regular (non-holiday) resort-weeks with at least minSnow cm of fresh snow (default 40) and a Crowd Index below maxCrowd (default 55). With the defaults it equals Quiet Powder Weeks.
item.name: Target Weeks

item.description: Target Weeks in 2025/26 minus 2024/25 under the same campaign rule (parameters minSnow, maxCrowd; defaults 40, 55). Written out in full rather than over the two season measures so the what-if parameters reach both sides.
item.name: Target Weeks Change vs Last Season
